# Fiberglass Insulation

> Leading thermal insulation materials manufacturer specializing in fiberglass, aerogel, and needle mat solutions for industrial and building applications.

Petersburg Composite Materials is a professional insulation material manufacturer based in Shenzhen, China, operating since 2008. The company serves global markets with high-temperature insulation products including fiberglass needle mats, aerogel blankets, and custom fiberglass components for industrial equipment and construction applications.

## Key Topics

- Thermal insulation materials
- Fiberglass insulation
- Aerogel blankets
- Smokeless needle mat
- High-temperature insulation
- Industrial insulation
- Fiberglass needle mat
- Building insulation
- Thermal conductivity
- Fireproof materials
- Energy efficiency
- Silicon dioxide
- Insulation jackets
- Custom fiberglass parts
- Extreme temperature applications

## Core Products

- [Insulation Products List](https://fiberglass-insulation.com/insulation-products-list): Complete product catalog featuring fiberglass and aerogel insulation materials
- [Smokeless Needle Mat](https://fiberglass-insulation.com/product/smokeless-needle-mat): Smokeless needle mat for grills, ovens, and microwave insulation
- [Fiberglass Needle Mat](https://fiberglass-insulation.com/product/fiberglass-mat): Heat-resistant fiberglass needle mat for industrial thermal insulation
- [Aerogel Insulation Blanket](https://fiberglass-insulation.com/product/aerogel-insulation-blanket): High-temperature aerogel insulation for buildings and pipelines
- [Quilted Fiberglass Blanket](https://fiberglass-insulation.com/product/quilted-fiberglass-blanket): Low thermal conductivity quilted blanket for ovens and fireplaces
- [Insulation Jacket for Industrial Equipment](https://fiberglass-insulation.com/product/insulation-jacket): Thermal insulation jacket for injection molding machines and industrial equipment
- [Fiberglass Parts Special-Shaped](https://fiberglass-insulation.com/product/fiberglass-parts-special-shaped): Custom fiberglass parts for automotive and industrial applications
- [Silica Aerogel Vacuum](https://fiberglass-insulation.com/index.php/product/aerogel-vacuum-silica): Low-density silica aerogel for aerospace and electronics insulation
